title: harness review findings
description: G17. The shape a headless review returns so a machine can dedupe it, count it and post it. Prose is still allowed — it lives in `detail` — but the parts a pipeline has to reason about are fields.

verdict.description: The reviewer's own last word. It advises the merge decision and never makes it.

file.description: Repository-relative path this finding is about.

line.description: 1-indexed line, or 0 when the finding is about the file as a whole.

title.description: One line, specific enough to recognise on a second pull request.

detail.description: The evidence and the reasoning, in prose.

detected_pattern.description: A short kebab-case slug naming the recurring class this finding is an instance of, such as unchecked-error-path or assertion-relaxed. The same defect on a later pull request must produce the same slug: this is what lets a repeat class be counted rather than rediscovered.

fix.description: One sentence written for the model: the judgment to make, not a restatement of the problem.

limitations.description: What this review could not establish. No tests were run by it; say so, and say what else was out of reach.
